caseStudies.title: OMG 3Q: renewing a gaming community after nine years
caseStudies.summary: VNGGames combined outfits inspired by Vietnamese culture, a 3H content approach, and livestreaming to connect players. The original case examines how a long-established brand turned its community heritage into a new experience.
caseStudies.question: Which activities serve existing players and which reach new players? Distinguish the objectives and evaluation metrics for each group.

caseStudies.title: Play Together: turning shared play into connection
caseStudies.summary: The campaign used playing with friends to connect social content, livestreaming, in-person activities, and in-game experiences. The original case considers attracting new players, retaining current players, and reminding former players of the game.
caseStudies.question: Which insight led to this strategic choice? What evidence would you use to assess its results?

caseStudies.title: VALORANT: Vietnamese identity at a regional tournament
caseStudies.summary: Riot Games and VNGGames incorporated Vietnamese cultural elements into the VCT Pacific Stage 1 experience in Ho Chi Minh City. The source explores how the host location became part of the event’s brand story.
caseStudies.question: How can an international event retain its brand identity while using local culture meaningfully rather than as decoration?

caseStudies.title: Clorox: Clean is the beginning
caseStudies.summary: Clorox extended its cleaning story to positive new beginnings in everyday life, drawing on a neuroscience-based argument. When reading the case, distinguish the brand message from scientific evidence and the conditions under which a claim applies.
caseStudies.question: What evidence supports the brand promise? Which campaign results are self-reported, and what would require independent verification?

caseStudies.title: NESCAFÉ Signature: Why not enjoy café-style coffee at home?
caseStudies.summary: NESCAFÉ used the inconveniences of going to a café to introduce an at-home coffee experience. The source describes connections between usage occasions, outdoor advertising, and a partnership with Grab.
caseStudies.question: How do the consumer insight, product benefit, and advertising context connect? What might limit a shift from café visits to coffee at home?
